THE HEIR IN THE RAIN
EPISODE 1 - "THE ENGAGEMENT"

[00:00] INT. MEHTA MANSION - BALLROOM - NIGHT
[00:02] Crystal chandeliers. Guests in silk and diamonds raise champagne flutes.
[00:05] MIRA KAPOOR, in a simple cotton saree, stands alone near the stage holding a small wrapped gift.
[00:09] LEELA MEHTA: (into the microphone) Thank you all for coming to celebrate my son Arjun.
[00:14] Leela spots Mira. Her smile vanishes.
[00:17] LEELA MEHTA: And of course... his fiancée. Mira, come up here, dear.
[00:21] Mira climbs the steps. Guests whisper.
[00:24] LEELA MEHTA: What did you bring us? Show everyone.
[00:27] Mira opens the box. A hand-painted silver frame.
[00:30] LEELA MEHTA: Silver plate. From a girl who wants to marry into the Mehta family.
[00:35] Leela drops the frame. It cracks on the marble floor. Guests laugh.
[00:39] MIRA: My mother painted that frame.
[00:42] LEELA MEHTA: Then your mother wasted her paint.
[00:45] Mira looks at ARJUN MEHTA. He looks away and sips his champagne.
[00:49] MIRA: Arjun, say something.
[00:52] ARJUN: Mira, please. Not here. You're making a scene.
[00:56] TANYA SETHI, Mira's best friend, steps forward and touches Arjun's arm.
[01:00] TANYA: Maybe you should go home, Mira. For Arjun's sake.
[01:04] Mira notices a smear of red lipstick on Arjun's white collar. The same deep red Tanya is wearing.
[01:09] MIRA: (quietly) Since when do you wear red, Tanya?
[01:12] Tanya's smile freezes for half a second.
[01:15] LEELA MEHTA: Enough. Security, show the gold digger out.
[01:19] MIRA: I never asked your son for a single rupee.
[01:23] Leela slaps Mira hard across the face. The music stops.
[01:26] LEELA MEHTA: Girls like you always say that.
[01:30] Silence. Mira touches her cheek. A gold locket engraved "V.R." slips out from under her blouse.
[01:35] EXT. MEHTA MANSION - FRONT STEPS - NIGHT
[01:37] Mira walks out into the rain, barefoot, holding the cracked frame.
[01:42] A black Rolls-Royce pulls up. A grey-haired man in a dark suit steps out with an umbrella.
[01:47] HARISH DESAI: Miss Kapoor? My name is Harish Desai.
[01:51] MIRA: I don't know you.
[01:53] HARISH DESAI: No. But I have been looking for you for twenty-two years.
[01:58] He holds the umbrella over her.
[02:01] HARISH DESAI: It's about your father.
[02:04] Mira freezes.
[02:06] CUT TO BLACK.
